about_the_game:
🫧 A Whimsical Bubble-Popping Adventure

Dive into this incremental clicker/idle hybrid with tower defense elements! Start as a lone bubble-popper, build a formidable cat army, and discover strategic synergies that’ll make your inner cat enthusiast purr with delight.

🎮 Gameplay 101

Pop bubbles → hire cats → dominate the bubble realm!

  • 🖱️ Click: Build satisfying combos and earn cash.

  • 🐈 Recruit: Assemble a quirky workforce from lazy paw-swipers to explosive Devilcats.

  • 📈 Invest: Unlock upgrades, powers, new cats, and discover new synergies.

  • 🗺️ Explore: Discover mysterious shrines housing extraordinarily rare cats.

  • 🔄 Ascend: Prestige with purpose, gaining permanent upgrades and unique abilities.

🐾 Meet Byte, The Inspiration!

This game's muse spends his days conducting gravity experiments (knocking stuff off counters) or battling his arch-nemesis (the mirror). His fascination with soap bubbles was too adorable to not immortalize in game form!

🤔 Choose Your Playstyle

  • 🧘 Zen Master: Relax as your cat army handles everything (while silently judging you).

  • 👹 Clicker Demon: Chase x25 combos until your mouse begs for mercy.

🌟 Features That Pop

  • 🐱 Cats: Unicats, Devilcats, and more — each with unique abilities and synergies.

  • 🎯 Play Your Way: Tower defense brainiac or zen bubble ASMR enthusiast.

  • 🚀 Prestige with Purpose: Unlock game-breaking perks, not just boring +1% bonuses.

  • 🌐 Endless Scale: Expand your map to host thousands of bubbles and cats.

  • ⏱️ Replay for Glory: Try speedrunning milestones after your first playthrough!

  • 🏆 Completionist Heaven: Over ~400 achievements to hunt and showcase.

💖 Crafted With Players In Mind

  • 🔋 Zero Cash Grabs: Everything’s included! No ads, no "gem" BS — just cats being weird.

  • 🍞 Toasters Welcome: Runs smoothly even on your laptop from 2001.

  • 💻 Open-Source Code: Rip it apart, make a Dog Mode, whatever.

  • 🪮 Authentic Cat Hair: Byte contributed to development by shedding on my keyboard.

⚔️ Declare War on Bubbles!

Click, strategize, explore, and ascend — the bubble realm awaits your feline army!
